glbs: assets/source/roster/<family>/ as committed at 2a68e25d7 (the spec commit); probed tier 0 in vehicle mode (wheels and tracks kept, dressing_* skipped)

convention.hull_box: reaches the hull and turret roof; where a bulky sight stands more than the 0.3 m bulky dressing allowance over the roof, the top is the sight's top less 0.3 m (decisions.md F-B1)
convention.pivot: centre of the turret ring; for a fixed mount, the point it is drawn hinged on (only pivot + muzzle reaches the simulation)
convention.muzzle: pivot_m + muzzle_m at rest, at the real barrel or launch point
convention.frame: hull box centred on x = 0 and y = 0, standing on z = 0; +x forward, +y left

thresholds.hull_dimension: fix when off by more than max(0.10 m, 3 %)
thresholds.pivot_x: fix when off by more than 0.15 m
thresholds.muzzle_point: fix when the world muzzle point is off by more than 0.15 m on any axis (added by lane F-B, decisions.md F-B3)
thresholds.eye_m: kept unless a source contradicts it; nothing measured here does

sources.note: 7.8 m hull, 3.7 m wide, 2.5 m high, about 10 m gun forward (Wikidata cites Rheinmetall's page for 7.8 / 3.7 / 2.5 m)
three-quarter and head-on only; kf51u-side.jpg is a close crop of the KF51U. Nothing measurable in a clean side view

verdicts.note: the Leopard 2A4 hull and ring, as the 2A6's

world x 6.4 m (10.3 m overall). Rheinmetall's rounded 'about 10 m' says 6.1 m (and 6.1 is the offset, the unsubtracted-pivot pattern); a 6.63 m L51 barrel on the Leopard 2 ring, scaled from the 2A6 (L55, 3.27 m past the nose), says about 7.2 m. The frame sits between two sources that disagree by more than the threshold, so it stays; slice 23 measures the drawn barrel when it rebuilds it

overlays.note: No drawing of the KF51 exists, free or on the-blueprints.com, and the photos are three-quarter views. No generated view was made: the published box agrees with the frame and a generated side view could not settle the barrel, which is the one open number.

notes.why: The frame's box and pivot agree with Rheinmetall. The model's turret is a short wedge set back on the hull; the photos show a long, flat, faceted turret whose sloped front runs out over the glacis, and a long thin 130 mm barrel with a large muzzle. Slice 23 rebuilds both with gun_tube; the muzzle's reach is the open number (see the verdict).
